t-becker-glidden.st: A period paper (Beloit Weekly News, 15 Dec 1893) puts the hut about 25 miles from Glidden and says searchers found nothing; the only direct account of the search (15 cents found) comes through Lesy's 1973 book. Direction from Glidden is not given, so the pin stays approximate.

set.tovw: Lead grade D: one period wire confirms the hermit's death and a fruitless 1893 search; the $50,000 figure is hearsay and the hut is unplaced.

src: Beloit Weekly News, 15 Dec 1893, p. 1 (state news)
